domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to build a risk report for, e.g. "example.com". A bare domain, not a full URL.

includeTechStack.title: Include tech stack check
includeTechStack.description: Fetch the site's homepage and detect CMS, ecommerce platform, JS framework, analytics, CDN, payment, and live-chat signatures.

includeSubdomains.title: Include subdomain discovery
includeSubdomains.description: Search Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh) for subdomains that have had a certificate issued.

maxSubdomains.title: Max subdomains returned
maxSubdomains.description: Cap on discovered subdomains listed per domain.

ctDaysBack.title: Certificate Transparency lookback (days)
ctDaysBack.description: How far back to search Certificate Transparency logs for subdomain discovery.
